exercises.instruction: Match the film types (a-f) in the box with the film titles and their plots (1-6).

column_a.1: The Chainsaw Massacre at Halloween — A killer with a severe mental illness escapes from a hospital on Halloween.
column_a.2: Men in Black — Two men try to save Earth after aliens threaten to destroy it.
column_a.3: Pirates of Southeast Asia — About modern-day pirates in Indonesia and Malaysia.
column_a.4: The Wise Little Hen — Donald Duck and his friend, Peter Pig, try to avoid work until Mrs Hen teaches the value of labour.
column_a.5: The Lord of the Rings — A hobbit (a small, friendly creature with big feet) must destroy a magic ring before an evil wizard gets it.
column_a.6: Mr Bean's Holiday — Many funny things happen after Mr Bean wins a trip to Cannes. He unintentionally separates a young boy from his father and must help the two reunite.

exercises.instruction: Read the text. Fill in the gaps with although / though or however.
exercises.passage_template: (1) ____ Mai had lots of homework to do, she agreed to go shopping with her friend Mark. Mark loves to buy jeans and T-shirts. (2) ____, Mai prefers to buy sportswear. (3) ____ it rained, they set off on Sunday morning for the town centre. Mark, as always, had more cash than Mai. (4) ____, Mai was better at buying things at a lower price. They were hungry and had lunch at the local burger bar. (5) ____ they had spent nearly all their money, there were still a few shops that Mark wanted to visit. (6) ____ they had aching feet, Mai and Mark ended up spending a few more hours shopping.

exercises.instruction: Read the text about the film The Theory of Everything and answer the questions that follow.
exercises.passage:
The Theory of Everything is a biographical film, directed by James Marsh in 2014. It stars Eddie Redmayne and Felicity Jones.
The film is about the life of the scientist Stephen Hawking. It was adapted by Anthony McCarten from the book Travelling to Infinity: My Life with Stephen by the scientist's wife, Jane Hawking. The film is set in England in the early 1960s. It tells the story of Hawking's relationship with his wife, the diagnosis of his motor neuron disease and his success in the field of physics.
The film received positive reviews. People say it is a must-see. I agree, because the story is moving and the acting is excellent. The music is also incredible.
Although The Theory of Everything is a little sad at times, its story is very interesting and there is a lot of action. Go and see it if you can.

exercises.instruction: This is Nick's letter to his friend telling him about his favourite film. Put the following paragraphs in the correct order.

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: Titanic is a romantic film, which was directed by James Cameron. It stars Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet. The film is about the sinking of the ship Titanic on its first voyage. The main characters are Jack Dawson and Rose DeWitt Bukater. Although they are from different social classes, and Rose is already engaged, they fall in love. I won't tell you what happens in case you want to watch it!

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
What about you? What type of films do you like? Have you been to the cinema lately? What did you see? Write back and tell me.
Yours,
Nick

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text:
Dear Mark,
How are you? I'm writing to tell you about the great film I saw last Saturday at the cinema. I went to see Titanic with some friends.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Titanic received a lot of positive reviews because the plot is moving and the acting is excellent. The special effects, visuals, and music are also incredible. I think it is worth watching.

exercises.note: Đáp án lấy từ trang Keys (tr.115). Dạng bài mới 'paragraph_ordering' — cần thiết kế giao diện kéo-thả hoặc chọn thứ tự riêng.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite these sentences using however as in the example. Example: Although she hated him at first, she fell in love with him in the end. → She hated him at first. However, she fell in love with him in the end.

questions.stem: Although the film didn't receive good reviews from critics, many people went to see it.
questions.answer: The film didn't receive good reviews from critics. However, many people went to see it.

questions.stem: Although the story is silly, many people enjoy the film.
questions.answer: The story is silly. However, many people enjoy the film.

questions.stem: Although they spent millions of dollars on making the film, it wasn't successful as expected.
questions.answer: They spent millions of dollars on making the film. However, it wasn't successful as expected.

questions.stem: Although Jaws is one of Spielberg's first films, it is one of his best.
questions.answer: Jaws is one of Spielberg's first films. However, it is one of his best.

questions.stem: Although the film was a bit frightening, I really enjoyed it.
questions.answer: The film was a bit frightening. However, I really enjoyed it.
